An '''Imperial officer''' received medical treatment aboard the [[Carosite]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'' during the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A [[Unidentified crime lord (Sudden Restoration attack)|crime lord]] hired a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Sudden Restoration attack)|bounty hunter]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Officer/Legends|officer]].
